novelty_scope: Relative to the inspected manuscript and incoming reports; historical equivalents of every explicit specialization have not been exhaustively excluded.

claims.title: Full Gaussian rank conjecture and canonical kernel
claims.scope: Exact rational single-product coefficient system with the removed divergent coordinate; not numerical period dimension.

claims.title: Universal cyclotomic same-point splitting
claims.scope: Every N>=3; odd-weight free sectors and the all-weight rank difference.

claims.title: Full level-three ranks
claims.scope: New full-rank extension of the previously proved residual invariant-ring result.

claims.title: No proper real subfield for a nonzero individual beta symbol
claims.scope: Individual beta_M(a) in the rational multiplicative exterior square, not arbitrary linear combinations.

claims.title: Complete formal reduction classification of J(p/q)
claims.scope: All positive reduced rational arguments, in the rationalized five-term calculus; no numerical nonidentity claim.

claims.title: Exact denominator obstruction rank and all relations
claims.scope: Formal symbol ranks and a formal-value lower bound modulo rational dilogarithms.

claims.title: Adjacent positive-argument functional identity
claims.scope: Known Choie-Kumar equation in a useful equivalent form; no new general-functional-equation priority claim.

claims.title: Consecutive rational log-sine evaluations
claims.scope: Full real analytic values, including constants and branches; proposed manuscript additions.

claims.title: Explicit rational-dilogarithm value J(3/5)
claims.scope: Full analytic identity on the positive real branch; rational core [1/3]-[1/5]/2.

claims.title: Complete small-rho zero classification and Puiseux branches
claims.scope: Fixed integers n,k, all sufficiently small positive rho; threshold existence is proved but no explicit numeric threshold is supplied.

claims.title: Forced interior multiple zeros at n=3,4 and k=1
claims.scope: Existence of a multiple zero event; neither uniqueness nor nondegeneracy is claimed.

claims.title: Positive initial velocity of the smallest n=4,k=3 zero
claims.scope: A concrete counterexample to a general decreasing-parameter extrapolation.

claims.title: Exactly two simple zeros for n=2 at every k and rho
claims.scope: All k>=1 and rho in [0,1]; sharp threshold K_2=1, right interlacing, and nonmonotonic first k=1 branch.

claims.title: Strict larger-branch monotonicity and unique level-one crossing
claims.scope: n=2,k=1; a2 strictly decreases, a1 crosses 1 once and increases thereafter.

claims.title: Abel singularity and exact simple-zero endpoint regularity
claims.scope: Fixed n,k, positive compact a-sets; simple endpoint zeros are C^(k-1), not C^k.

claims.title: Complete angular-zero expansion at every exponential scale
claims.scope: a tends through positive integers; uniform over all real b>0 for each fixed cutoff.

claims.title: Ten angular terms and a sharp signed remainder
claims.scope: Explicit harmonic-number coefficients; eventual strict sign uniform in b>0.

claims.title: Divergence even after equal exponential bases are combined
claims.scope: For every fixed integer a>=1 and b>0; a prime-indexed sequence of terms is unbounded.

claims.title: Unique stationary point of the smaller two-zero branch
claims.scope: n=2,k=1; motivated by the numerical figure and proved shape constraints. No global stationary-point exclusion is provided.
